ossinsight_notice.heading: Star-based rankings are paused
ossinsight_notice.text: GitHub changed how its public events feed is paginated, and our ingestion read only the first slice, so star, pull request and issue events since mid-2025 were badly under-captured. Rankings that depend on those counts would be misleading, so we pause them instead of publishing numbers we know are wrong. History before May 2025, repository totals synced directly from GitHub, and commit activity are unaffected.
